create_writable_stream: create a WritableStream instance from a ChannelOwner parent with type, guid, and initializer
copy_file_to_stream: copy a local file to a WritableStream by reading chunks and sending base64-encoded data
close_writable_stream: close a WritableStream channel after writing all data
read_file_in_chunks: read a file in COPY_BUFSIZE chunks (64KB or 1MB depending on platform)
base64_encode_stream_data: base64-encode binary file chunks before sending them over the stream channel
